```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |> schema()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  write_dataset(
    path = "data/prices_by_coin",
    format = "parquet",
    partitioning = "coin_id"
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_raw, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(market_cap_trillions = market_cap_usd / 1e12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_raw, y = market_cap_trillions)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
prices |>
  mutate(
    market_cap_billions = market_cap_usd / 1e9,
    coin_id = fct_reorder(
      coin_id,
      market_cap_billions,
      .fun = median,
      .desc = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = coin_id, y = market_cap_billions)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10()
```

```{r}
intersect(names(metadata), names(categories))

metadata |>
  mutate(
    launch_date_parsed = as.Date(
      parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("B d, Y", "Y-m-d"))
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    coin_id,
    coin_name,
    category_id,
    launch_date,
    launch_date_parsed,
    description
  ) |>
  left_join(
    categories |>
      rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  ) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  reframe(range(date))
```

```{r}
crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw))

crypto |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(total_market_cap_trillions = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_market_cap_trillions)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  left_join(metadata |> select(coin_id, category_id), by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(categories |> select(category_id, category_name), by = "category_id") |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(
    market_cap_trillions = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e12,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    category_name = fct_reorder(
      category_name,
      market_cap_trillions,
      .fun = median,
      .desc = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = market_cap_trillions, color = category_name)) +
  geom_rect(
    xmin = as.Date("2022-05-07"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-05-12"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey40",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    xmin = as.Date("2022-11-08"),
    xmax = as.Date("2022-11-11"),
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey40",
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-05-09"),
    y = Inf,
    label = "Luna/UST crash",
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = as.Date("2022-11-09"),
    y = Inf,
    label = "FTX collapse",
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market Cap by Category",
    subtitle = "Daily market-cap totals for coins in each category, shown in trillions of U.S. dollars",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Market cap (trillions of U.S. dollars)",
    color = "Category",
    caption = "Source: daily_prices.parquet, coin_metadata.parquet, and categories.parquet"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
